title: Ubertooth Standalone App
description: Windows standalone Tauri app (Rust backend) that directly spawns ubertooth-*.exe binaries without Node.js dependency

stories.title: Project Scaffolding & Build
acceptanceCriteria: ubertooth-standalone/ directory exists with Cargo.toml, package.json, src-tauri/, src/ ✓
src-tauri/resources/ contains all 16 ubertooth binaries and DLLs ✓
cargo check passes (exit 0, 32.18s) ✓
npm install completes without errors ✓
grep -r 'ubertooth-windows-host' ubertooth-standalone/ returns exit 1 (no matches) ✓
